capabilities: Record audio with selectable quality and format
Visualize the input signal and clipping
Monitor audio input and show file size and duration
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Gain control, noise suppression, and voice isolation are not available on iOS. The Installation section is empty apart from a dangling reference.
problem: Obsidian's built-in audio recorder lacks quality settings, input device choice, and visual feedback of the recording signal.
summary: Audio recorder that records with selectable input device, output format and bitrate, waveform display, and monitoring.
